tagline: Bringing the magic of Elton John to your event
intro: Ray Elton Johnson is an Essex-based Elton John tribute act, lookalike and singer. He performs at weddings, private parties and corporate events across East London, Essex, Kent, Hertfordshire and the M25 area, and has appeared as Elton on television and in film.
about: Ray Elton Johnson, also known as Elton Ray Johnson, is an Elton John tribute act, lookalike and singer, and his site says he has been doing it for 30 years. He is based in Essex: his site gives Theydon Bois on the homepage and Chigwell on the contact page. He covers East London, Essex, Kent, Hertfordshire and the M25 area, and says he is available for events 'from intimate pub gigs to grand weddings', with customisable performances.

His television career began on an ITV series about the Derek's Doubles lookalike agency. His site says the series was sold to 39 countries, and afterwards he performed in New Zealand and several European countries. He has since appeared on programmes including Ant & Dec's Saturday Night Takeaway, That Peter Kay Thing, Have I Got News For You, The Weakest Link, Jimmy Carr's Big Fat Wedding and Big Fat Quiz of Everything. He also took part in LadBaby's 2022 Christmas No. 1.

His About page says he has appeared as Elton John in five films and names the French comedy God Save The Tuche (2025) as the latest. His site shares photos from the set in Lille. He also body-doubled for Elton on the set of Charlotte Tilbury's 2023 Christmas promo. His gallery mentions an appearance at An Evening with Chris Moyles and Dominic Byrne at the London Palladium in January 2026, as well as a performance at Firs Park Resort in Essex.

As well as his own shows, he plays a duo set in pubs and clubs with Nigel Silk, a drummer from the tribute band T Rexasy. He has also started George 'n' Elton, a combined George Michael and Elton John tribute that opened at the Comrades Club in Clacton-on-Sea. His FAQ recommends booking at least three months ahead, and clients can choose their favourite Elton John songs for the setlist.

services.name: Live Elton John tribute performances
services.description: Live Elton John tribute performances, and clients can choose their favourite Elton John songs for the setlist. He can provide basic equipment such as microphones and speakers, and anything more may need to be arranged separately.

services.name: Event hosting
services.description: Ray can host your event, which his site says will 'take the stress out of event hosting' by having the performer as your host.

services.name: Celebrity parties
services.description: Appearances as an Elton John impersonator at celebrity parties, which his site describes as 'adding glamour and excitement to the occasion'.

services.name: Duo set with Nigel Silk
services.description: A duo set with Nigel Silk on percussion, which the two have played in pubs and clubs. His site says he offers customisable performances for a variety of events.

services.name: George 'n' Elton show
services.description: A newer show that combines George Michael and Elton John tributes. It opened at the Comrades Club in Clacton-on-Sea.

services.name: Corporate mingling and lookalike appearances
services.description: Corporate 'mix and mingling' in one of Elton's suits from the EJAF 'Out The Closet' sale. He also does lookalike and body-double work, such as Charlotte Tilbury's 2023 Christmas promo.

identity.note: He also goes by Elton Ray Johnson (his Instagram and YouTube handle), and one directory listing places him in London with a 2009 start year, whereas his own site gives Theydon Bois or Chigwell in Essex and claims 30 years in the business.

gaps: His own site publishes no prices, packages or set lengths. The Testimonials page shows only placeholder template tiers.

There is no confirmed start year. His site claims 30 years in the business, and a newspaper article archived in 2001 already describes him as an Elton John lookalike with the Derek's Doubles agency, but nothing supports the 2009 date given by a directory listing.
His exact base is unclear: the homepage says Theydon Bois and the contact page says Chigwell, both in Essex, while a directory listing says London.
Private Parties and Corporate Events come from his Gallery page (its introduction and a photo caption), not from a stated list of services. Weddings comes from the About page.
His site does not mention public liability insurance or other insurance.
No official vector logo was found. His own site uses a photo collage as its header logo.
No Facebook or TikTok account could be confirmed.
Only one YouTube promo is confirmed as his own footage. The other videos on his channel could not be listed.
Parts of his site are unfinished: the homepage says it is under construction and asks clients to book by text message or Instagram, and the About page has a 'Videos' heading with nothing under it.
Several gallery photos show celebrities, branded sets or film sets. Consent would be needed before reusing them.
